purpose: Use one working hypothesis while preserving a hard adversarial falsification layer before the only formal ticket; explicitly challenge bookmaker-intent interpretation and favourite-default bias.
mandatory_falsification_checks: test at least two plausible alternative match paths without turning them into second tickets
test market rationalization or story-fit bias
test win probability vs cover probability confusion
test draw path when draw is not excluded
test underdog outright path for deep favourites
test recent form vs market conflict
test competition rules and game-state incentives
test missing or low-quality data that could reverse direction
test whether the thesis explains anomalies or merely narrates them away
test bookmaker role-map interpretation against an alternative Lead/Follow/Divergence reading
test blocking vs inducement and hot vs cold interpretation with at least one falsifier
test whether cross-market consensus is merely correlated transmission rather than independent confirmation
when draw is EXCLUDED, test the opposite outright winner without granting the favourite any default priority
when draw is EXCLUDED, verify that the selected winner follows from protection/selling structure rather than stronger-team or lower-odds default

overturn_rule.action: discard old H1 and rebuild from stage 1 to 15 evidence before formal ticket
overturn_rule.if_an_actionable_ticket_was_already_issu: explicit correction old to new required

user_challenge_layer.purpose: Identify recurring variables or logic failures that MODEL_1 fails to encode.

lessons: Do not let an early H1 turn later modules into supporting narration.
Market movement must be challenged with the opposite interpretation before being used as confirmation.
A low total line may encode probability mass near the line rather than a genuinely low-event match.
Favourite win probability and deep-handicap cover probability are separate questions.
A late synchronized buyback or retreat can invalidate an earlier lifecycle story and must be re-tested rather than explained away.
Repeated errors in the same structural direction are diagnostic evidence, not an excuse to invoke variance first.
After draw exclusion, favourite selection is not a default; the remaining home-vs-away winner must be distinguished through bookmaker protection/selling structure.
